newsitem.title: JAPAN: Capcom sees 30 pct profit growth annually.
newsitem.headline: Capcom sees 30 pct profit growth annually.

text.p: Japanese computer game software firm Capcom Co Ltd expects its parent current profits to grow more than 30 percent annually in the medium-term and surpass its record figure sometime in the next five years.

"I expect our parent current profit will grow more than 30 percent each year from this year, surpassing our record parent current profit (of 14.44 billion yen in 93/94 ) in five years," Capcom president Kenzo Tsujimoto said in an interview.
Tsujimoto also said he would like to keep his promise to Capcom shareholders that the company would pay a total of 97.50 yen in dividends in the three years ending March 1997.
